answer: Cross-identity liability ledger.** Each new identity inherits the recorded dispute history of any identity funded from the same source wallet, so clones cannot shed a bad record. A jade-tier clean history earns faster settlement; a clone starts in default tier. An attacker must fund and operate each clone independently for months to reach that horizon, since shared funding links records. Honest agents never pay this isolation cost; those who wander across wallets still carry their ledger.
